parameters.jsCode: const crypto=require('crypto');const i=$json,b=i.body??i;if(String(i.headers?.['x-webhook-secret']??'')!==$env.REPUTATION_WEBHOOK_SECRET)throw new Error('unauthorized');for(const k of['sourceEventId','channel','customerId','serviceEventId','rating','serviceCompleted'])if(b[k]===undefined||b[k]==='')throw new Error(`missing ${k}`);const idempotencyKey=crypto.createHash('sha256').update(`${String(b.channel).toLowerCase()}:${b.sourceEventId}`).digest('hex');return[{json:{...b,idempotencyKey}}];

parameters.query: WITH i AS (INSERT INTO feedback_events(idempotency_key,source_event_id,channel,payload) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4::jsonb) ON CONFLICT(idempotency_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING id) SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM i) AS is_new;

WITH f AS (INSERT INTO feedback_records(idempotency_key,customer_id,service_event_id,rating,message_redacted,sentiment,risk,status,consent_to_contact,opted_out) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,'triaged',$8,$9) ON CONFLICT(idempotency_key) DO UPDATE SET updated_at=now() RETURNING id,customer_id), invite AS (INSERT INTO review_invites(feedback_id,customer_id,status,neutral_template_version,review_url,eligible_reason,scheduled_at,expires_at) SELECT id,customer_id,'pending','neutral_template_v1','http://localhost/review','eligible',now()+interval '24 hours',now()+interval '14 days' FROM f WHERE $10=true ON CONFLICT(feedback_id) DO NOTHING), recovery AS (INSERT INTO recovery_cases(feedback_id,customer_id,severity,status,sla_due_at) SELECT id,customer_id,$7,'open',CASE WHEN $7='high' THEN now()+interval '1 hour' ELSE now()+interval '24 hours' END FROM f WHERE $11=true ON CONFLICT(feedback_id) DO NOTHING) SELECT (SELECT id FROM f) AS feedback_id,$12::boolean AS reviewGatingApplied;
